_comment: Deliberate, named differences the parity harness accepts on listed steps only (backend/PORTING.md §14). A listed step must still have equal status and body; only the named headers may differ, and only in the stated direction. run.mjs prints an entry that no longer applies as STALE ALLOWANCE (remove it).

D-500-HEADERS.reason: Python's catch-all 500 comes from Starlette's ServerErrorMiddleware, outside the security-headers middleware, so it carries none; the Rust port answers the same status and body with its security headers (stricter, same decision as the other two ports).
